text.content:
Latin name: Via Bestiae

Virtues: Conviction, Instinct

Believed to be the oldest of the philosophies, the Road of the Beast is also the most innate to the newly Embraced. Viewed by the High Clans as crass and base, Via Bestiae is based on raw instinct and impulse. Followers (Ferals) take on feral personalities, regarding themselves as predators without equal, abandoning society and reacting only through instinct. They respect only those stronger than themselves, value their freedom above all, and give their trust only to those who have earned it. This road is most popular with the Low Clans, especially the Gangrel; very few High Clan vampires follow it, and those who do are quickly exiled from princely courts.

The Ethics:

  • Exist in accord with the needs of the Beast.
  • Do what you must to survive. No more, no less.
  • Mercy is for the weak. Only the strong survive.
  • The past is over, the future is not yet written. There is only the present.
  • Respect only the strong, and swear fealty to no one.

Aura of Conviction (Menace): Menace. Being in the presence of a true predator instills dread in lesser creatures; disciples of Via Bestiae emanate this trepidation, gaining an aura modifier when terrifying or cowing an opponent.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Putting yourself at risk needlessly; not challenging a weak defender.
  2. Killing for any reason other than survival; avoiding contact with nature.
  3. Needless torture or cruelty; making a sacrifice for someone unrelated to you.
  4. Refusing to kill when important to your survival; failing to defend your territory.
  5. Showing mercy to an enemy; abstaining from feeding when hungry.

vtmlarp.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
